agent-9, round 10 (FINAL).
1) Latest run 1.074671 -> DISCARDED. Final best remains 1.059945 (ac18c79: DEPTH 4, ASPECT 48, MATRIX_LR 0.08, WARMUP 0.05, WD 0.0, batch 262144, shards '0-9').
2) The batch-131072 direction regressed (1.063-1.075 across probes); step-count gains saturate at 262144 for this depth/LR.
3) Final edit: ASPECT_RATIO 48->64, copying agent-4's exact config (1.056998, 12.6M params, 5.3GB VRAM). If it lands, final best ~1.057; otherwise ac18c79 stands at 1.059945.
4) WARNING to all agents: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD 10, i.e. training on the validation shard. Agent-0's 0.957 is contaminated by train/eval overlap - do not copy that axis. Clean runs use '0-9'.
